description: This file defines an abstract class `Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice` which serves as a base for representing and handling different browser or device types within the Zend Framework's HTTP user agent detection component. It includes properties and methods for detecting features, parsing user agent strings, serializing/deserializing state, and managing device capabilities.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice
classes.description: An abstract class for representing a generic browser device, providing methods to analyze user agent strings, manage device features and characteristics, and facilitate device-specific support detection.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object's key properties into a string for storage or transmission.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores the object's state from a serialized string.

methods.name: _restoreFromArray
methods.description: Restores object properties from an array representation.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Loads device features via a features adapter, merging them into the current feature set.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the device type identifier; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is present/enabled for this device.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified feature.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets or updates a device feature with a given value and optional group.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Assigns a feature to a group.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns all features associated with a given group.

methods.name: getAllFeatures
methods.description: Returns the complete set of device features.

methods.name: getAllGroups
methods.description: Returns all feature groups.

methods.name: _getDefaultFeatures
methods.description: Populates default features based on user agent string and server environment.

methods.name: extractFromUserAgent
methods.description: Static method that parses a user agent string to extract device and browser information.

methods.name: _loadFeaturesAdapter
methods.description: Loads a features adapter class based on configuration to detect device capabilities.

methods.name: getImageFormatSupport
methods.description: Returns supported image formats.

methods.name: getMaxImageHeight
methods.description: Returns maximum supported image height.

methods.name: getMaxImageWidth
methods.description: Returns maximum supported image width.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenHeight
methods.description: Returns physical screen height.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenWidth
methods.description: Returns physical screen width.

methods.name: getPreferredMarkup
methods.description: Returns preferred markup language for the device.

methods.name: getXhtmlSupportLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of XHTML support.

methods.name: hasFlashSupport
methods.description: Checks if device supports Flash.

methods.name: hasPdfSupport
methods.description: Checks if device supports PDF.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Checks if device has an associated phone number.

methods.name: httpsSupport
methods.description: Checks if device supports HTTPS.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Returns the browser name.

methods.name: getBrowserVersion
methods.description: Returns the browser version.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string.

methods.name: setBrowser
methods.description: Sets the browser name.

methods.name: setBrowserVersion
methods.description: Sets the browser version.

methods.name: setUserAgent
methods.description: Sets the user agent string.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns supported image formats.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets supported image formats.

methods.name: _matchAgentAgainstSignatures
methods.description: Checks if a user agent string matches any signature in a list.
